6.?

Consider the following differential equation.

6x2y″+x(6x−1)y′−3y=0 Which of the following is a Frobenius series solution to the differential equation given above, where an for n=0,1,2,… are constants determined by substitution?

Hint: Substituting a trial Frobenius series solution into each term of the ODE, we obtain 6x2y″=6(λ2−λ)a0xλ+6∑n=1∞((λ+n)2−(λ+n))anxλ+n,x(6x−1)y′=−λa0xλ+∑n=1∞[6(λ+n−1)an−1−(λ+n)an]xλ+n,−3y=−3a0xλ−3∑n=1∞anxλ+n.
